variants.label: Embedded View
variants.tooltip: Enables an entire view to be embedded within another view.

path.description: Path of embedded view to display

params.description: Parameters for the view. If passing parameters into the embedded view, the names here must match the parameters on that view.

useDefaultViewWidth.description: Use of view's default width instead of adjusting based on the content's width.

useDefaultViewHeight.description: Use of view's default height instead of adjusting based on the content's height.

order.description: Controls when the embedded view loads: after the parent is displayed or combined with the parent view loading
